entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.

3. The petitioners are accused Nos.1 to 4 in Crime No.160 of 2020 of Bangarupalem Police Station,
Chittoor District.

4. A case under Sections 188, 328, 270, 273, 420 of IPC; Section 24(1) r/w.27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short "the COTPA"); Section 3 of the Epidemic Disease Act, 1897; Section 59(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act and Section 4 of the Gutka and Pan Masala (Prohibition) Act, was registered against the petitioners.

entities.text:
Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. At the time of hearing, this Criminal Petition, both learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State, would submit that this is a covered case, and in the earlier Criminal Petition No.3558 of 2020, this Court quashed the F.1.R. on the similar allegations for the similar offences registered against the petitioner therein.

Therefore, learned counsel for the To, APWN> petitioner would submit that the petitioners, who are similarly placed,
are also entitled for quash of F.I.R. in view of the earlier order passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3558 of 2020,  dated 02.09.2020.
6.

A perusal of the order dated 02.09.2020 passed in Crl.P.No.3558 of 2020 would show that the F.I.R. registered for the similar offences against the petitioner therein was quashed by this Court on the ground that the prosecution is not maintainable.

Therefore, the petitioners, who are facing the prosecution on the basis of the similar allegations and for the similar offences registered against them, who are also similarly placed, are entitled to the said relief of quashing the F.I.R.
7.

Therefore, in view of the earlier order passed by this Court in Crl.Petition No.3558 of 2020, dated 02.09.2020, quashing the F.I.R. against the petitioner therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the F.I-R. in Crime No.160 of 2020 of Bangarupalem Police Station, Chittoor District, registered against the petitioners herein, is hereby quashed.

Consequently, miscellaneous applications,
pending if any, shall also stand closed.
Sd/-M.SURYANADHA REDDY ASSISTANT, REGISTR TRUE COPY//
For ASSISTANT REGKTRAR The Ill Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Chittoor.
